sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of sarecycline during breastfeeding. For acne treatment, it is taken for 12 weeks or longer. Such prolonged courses of tetracyclines are not recommended because if even a small fraction is absorbed by the infant from milk, it could have a cumulative staining effect on the infant’s permanent teeth.
